assertions.evidence: In lead_routing.ts, `classifyLead` checks `lead.headcount > 1000 || new Set(lead.regions).size >= 3` and returns "enterprise" before `decideCompanyWideRollout` is ever called.
`makeJevRolloutChecker` POSTs to "https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions" with `model: "typesafe/jev-1.13"`, a version-pinned model ID.
The request body sends `state: { looking_for: lookingFor }`, so neither headcount nor region data reaches the model.
